exposure: Proposed alternative private sector maternity care model
outcome: Stakeholder feedback and emergent themes regarding new maternity care models
Support for legislative reforms and new care models
cohort: The participants were purposively selected stakeholders engaged in a deliberative dialogue to discuss a proposed alternative maternity care model.
finding: Stakeholders expressed strong support for the further development of alternative private sector maternity care models in South Africa, emphasizing women-centred, team-based approaches and the need for legislative reforms.
mod_finding: Findings highlighted the need for targeted education to address fears and misperceptions about midwife-led vaginal birth and to reduce fears of spontaneous labour and vaginal births.
